Directed by Ángel Gómez Hernández

Starring Matilda Lutz, Gregg Sulkin, Melina Matthews, William Miller

NZ Premiere

Be the first to see the new spider horror CRAWLERS at the New Zealand Premiere!

Guaranteed to make you squirm in your seat more than once, this is a must see in a dark cinema.

--- A catastrophic infestation of venomous and deadly spiders sends an apartment building into lockdown. Trapped inside by a police-mandated quarantine, building manager Serena and her residents battle to survive as the creatures multiply by the second. Armed with her intimate knowledge of the complex, Serena may be the only one who can keep them alive—if she can confront her deepest fear. ---

Directed by Frank Oz

Starring Rick Moranis, Steve Martin, Ellen Greene, Vincent Gardenia

The ultimate genre musical celebrates it's 40th Anniversary at Terror-FI!

96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 66 reviews! If you've not had the chance to see this in a cinema before ... dance your way to down to Terror-Fi to experience LITTLE SHOP OF HORRORS in all its glory.

These are the only 40th Anniversary screenings ... don't miss out!

--- Meek flower shop assistant Seymour pines for co-worker Audrey. During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin, to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. ---

We will be screening the Director's Cut of the film.

Directed by Quarxx .

Starring Thierry Frémont, Zélie Rixhon

LES AMES EN PEINE

Do not miss the New Zealand Premiere of THE ONES WHO GRIEVE.

Just when you thought zombie films had nothing left to offer, along comes this visceral gut punch of a film, where man is the one the undead should fear. Thierry Frémont portrayal of Jacob will give you chills – hands down 2026's most terrifying villain.

This will be your only chance to see THE ONES WHO GRIEVE in the cinema.

--- At the end of the 19th century, on an isolated farm, Zélie is trapped under the authority of her father, Jacob, a deeply religious man. As a mysterious disease known as the "Black Veil" ravages the surrounding countryside and faith begins to blur with madness, she must fight to preserve her humanity and claim her freedom. ---

Festivals: Sitges 26, Fantastic Fest 26

Directed by Óscar Martín

Starring Pauline Brisy, Diego Anido, Victoria Cerrada

Be the first to see the haunting gothic horror vampire film UPIRO at the New Zealand Premiere.

Based on an actual case recognized by the Catholic Church as vampirism, the unexpected final act with will leave you reeling – placing the film among the best in the vampire genre in years.

This will be your only chance to see UPIRO in cinemas.

--- The year 1755. A young woman is confined in a cloistered convent in Calasparra, Murcia, where she discovers that several novices suffer a strange blood disease. A Franciscan expert in alchemy and esoteric treatises investigates the dark events, but his methods clash with the prevailing Scientific Thought of the Age of Enlightenment. ---

Festivals: Sitges 26, Fantastic Fest 26

events.long_description:
Details

Directed by Zachary Wigon

Starring Jason Isaacs, Thomasin McKenzie, Maika Monroe, Jacobi Jupe, Evie Templeton

NZ Premiere

Be the first to see the twisted period horror/thriller VICTORIAN PSYCHO at the New Zealand Premiere!

After wowing the crowds at Cannes, the film hits our shores – with a delightfully unhinged performance from Maika Monroe and our own Thomasin McKenzie in support.

--- In the Year of our Lord 1858, an unusual governess named Winifred Notty arrives at the gothic manor known as Ensor House. Winifred's responsibilities include teaching the children table manners and educating them about their family history -- all whilst hiding her own psychopathic tendencies. But as staff members begin disappearing, the owners of the estate start to wonder if there may be something amiss with their new governess... Victorian Psycho invites us into the mind of a psychopath -- trapped in a world she cannot control, living on the border between insurrection and madness. ---
